title: TEX-MEX: Similarity-Guided Temporal Contrastive Learning for Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2610.19557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contrastive learning for time series depends on deciding which pairs of inputs should be treated as similar and dissimilar. Because few augmentations reliably preserve meaning in time series, prior methods have relied on two disjoint notions of similarity between windows: structural similarity, which relates windows with similar morphology, and temporal similarity, which relates windows that occur close together in time. We introduce TEX-MEX, to our knowledge the first approach to unify the two into a single relationship. Given a random batch of windows drawn across the dataset, TEX-MEX uses the encoder to identify which windows are structurally similar or dissimilar to each other. It then pulls each window toward the temporally shifted versions of similar windows and pushes it away from those of dissimilar ones, learning what typically accompanies similar windows in time. translated_title: TEX-MEX：面向时间序列的相似性引导时序对比学习
translated_abstract: 时间序列的对比学习依赖于决定哪些输入对应当被视为相似、哪些应被视为不相似。由于很少有数据增强能够可靠地保留时间序列的语义，先前的方法依赖两种互不相交的窗口相似性概念：结构相似性，即关联形态相似的窗口；以及时序相似性，即关联在时间上接近出现的窗口。我们提出了TEX-MEX，据我们所知，这是首个将两者统一为单一关系的方法。给定从整个数据集中随机抽取的一批窗口，TEX-MEX利用编码器识别哪些窗口在结构上彼此相似或不相似，然后将每个窗口拉向相似窗口的时移版本，并推离不相似窗口的时移版本，从而学习在时间上通常与相似窗口相伴出现的模式。在PPG、EEG、ECG、加速度计和连续血糖监测等数据上……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TEX-MEX首次将时间序列的结构相似性与时序相似性统一到单一对比学习框架中，通过编码器识别结构相似窗口，将样本拉向其时移版本、推离不相似窗口的时移版本，从而学习相似窗口在时间上通常伴随出现的模式。
en_tdlr: TEX-MEX is the first method to unify structural and temporal similarity into a single contrastive relationship for time series, using the encoder to identify structurally similar windows and pulling each window toward (or pushing it away from) temporally shifted versions of similar (or dissimilar) windows to learn what typically accompanies similar windows in time.
